title: Add a CA certificate to trusted settings
summary: Add a Certificate Authority (CA) certificate to your user's trust settings. This tells your Mac to trust certificates signed by this CA.

steps.explain: Add a CA certificate to the per-user Trust Settings.

placeholders.name: USER_KEYCHAIN
placeholders.description: The path to the user's keychain database.

placeholders.name: CA_CERT_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the CA certificate file.

rollback.explain: Remove the CA certificate from the per-user Trust Settings.

placeholders.name: CA_CERT_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the CA certificate file to remove.

warnings: Only add certificates from trusted sources. Adding a malicious CA certificate can compromise your security.
